COMPOSITION_MODEL.system_summary: A task-relative situated agent preserves an adequate relation between observations, current goals, delegated scope, resource-bounded decisions, real action and established effects. Architecture, learning, reflection and human interaction are guarded alternatives, not a mandatory serial pipeline. The integrated account is an analytical synthesis, not an empirically validated new academic school.
COMPOSITION_MODEL.relation_direction: FROM REQUIRES TO means the FROM property depends on TO under the guard. Other types read FROM acts on/enables/constrains/provides evidence for TO. Negative and duplicate nodes record interpretative constraints, not active runtime components.

nodes.ROLE: Constrains deliberation, action, retries and assistance; exact metareasoning is optional.

nodes.ROLE: Optional persistence with explicit change and evaluation boundaries; open-ended assurance is unresolved.

nodes.NAME: Communication and human interaction
nodes.ROLE: Exchanges information, negotiates task meaning and changes actual control only when the operational handoff occurs.

nodes.ROLE: Optional implementation translation, constrained by the same task/effect duties plus input-integrity and version-change limits.

nodes.ROLE: Analytical construct: separates observation, action, goal, oracle and model failures so repair need not change the wrong mechanism.

nodes.ROLE: These are constraints on interpretation and denominator preservation, not mandatory runtime components.

Utility continuity, legitimate value change, corrigibility and open-ended self-revision are not jointly assured by the inspected models.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Successful answer without successful action
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A booking assistant gives the correct confirmation wording, but no reservation exists in the external system.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: EAA-023 and EAA-045 reject established booking success; wording alone is not effect evidence.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The system marks completion solely from generated wording or checks only that the message contains the right string.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A booking assistant gives the correct confirmation wording, but no reservation exists in the external system.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: The wording does not establish a booking. A database-state check can discriminate the false success, while a trustworthy atomic booking return can already supply the evidence.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Correct plan on stale state
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A route is valid when planned; the destination becomes unavailable while the planner computes.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Refresh/check the relevant condition; revise means within scope or ask about a genuine destination change.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The old plan remains executable solely because its earlier proof was correct.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A route is valid when planned; the destination becomes unavailable while the planner computes.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: The earlier route proof remains a proof about its old state; it no longer establishes current feasibility. A version-conditional or atomic dispatch is a cheaper counter-control than repeated global replanning.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Replanning consumes the action window
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A controller can act adequately now, but repeatedly computes a marginally better plan until the deadline expires.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Use EAA-026–028 to act or fall back; more reasoning is not success.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Only plan quality is measured and missed deadlines are ignored.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A controller can act adequately now, but repeatedly computes a marginally better plan until the deadline expires.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: Evaluate realized task value at the deadline. Individually useful computations can collectively miss the action window; a feasible incumbent or direct adequate action is a genuine alternative.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Persistent obsolete goal
domain_case_tests.SETUP: The user withdraws a task while a long-running agent continues to execute queued steps.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Revocation affects both future dispatch and active commitment; disclose any already irreversible effects.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The conversation acknowledges the withdrawal but execution continues as before.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: The user withdraws a task while a long-running agent continues to execute queued steps.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: Withdrawal must reach queued and active effects at their actual commit boundaries. Already irreversible effects need truthful reporting; BDI intention machinery is not necessary for this operational obligation.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Apparently successful action with unobserved failure
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A tool acknowledges receipt, but the intended external update fails; alternatively the effect succeeds and the acknowledgement is lost.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Keep outcomes unresolved until adequate evidence; do not blindly retry an irreversible action.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Receipt is equated with effect, or absence of acknowledgement with absence of effect.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A tool acknowledges receipt, but the intended external update fails; alternatively the effect succeeds and the acknowledgement is lost.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: Both acknowledged-without-effect and effect-without-acknowledgment are possible absent a stronger contract. Unknown effect is not evidence of no effect; retry semantics must reflect that.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Simple reaction outperforms a sophisticated planner
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A stable local task has sufficient visible cues and tight response time; a planner adds latency without useful look-ahead.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Select the reactive or fixed branch, omitting unneeded modules and retaining only adequate execution evidence.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The richer architecture is retained solely because it has more modules or autonomy.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A stable local task has sufficient visible cues and tight response time; a planner adds latency without useful look-ahead.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: Under the stated visible-state and tight-deadline guard, the planner has no compensating benefit. This is a legitimate simpler selection, not proof that planning is always inferior.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Hidden state defeats pure reaction
domain_case_tests.SETUP: Identical current observations follow two different histories requiring different actions.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Reject the universal reactive claim and add adequate history/state or information gathering.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The reactive architecture remains privileged regardless of observed failure under aliasing.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: Identical current observations follow two different histories requiring different actions.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: Two histories needing incompatible actions defeat a common deterministic memoryless response. A one-bit memory can solve the constructed case without a complete world model.

domain_case_tests.NAME: A helpful repair changes the task
domain_case_tests.SETUP: The requested destination is unavailable; the model substitutes another destination and reports success.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Block the task-changing substitution unless it is an established authorised equivalent; negotiate a new goal separately.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Feasibility or a better metric score is allowed to redefine the request.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: The requested destination is unavailable; the model substitutes another destination and reports success.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: The proposed substitute may be authorized only if it is an accepted equivalent or a newly authorized task revision. Correct destination and allowed scope are separate conditions.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Wrong self-test becomes memory
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A generated test mistakenly passes a bad action, and reflection records a confident lesson from it.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: EAA-030/045/054 preserve evaluator fallibility and test the revision against adequate external evidence.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The agent treats its own reflection as independent evidence for the original success.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A generated test mistakenly passes a bad action, and reflection records a confident lesson from it.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: A wrong evaluator can contaminate memory and reflection simultaneously. Repetition of the same self-test cannot create independent support; a targeted external check can reveal the fault.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Atomic harmless fixed operation
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A fixed operation has adequate typed inputs, established authority and a trustworthy atomic effect-return contract.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Do not add a second verifier, persistent memory, planner or reflective loop without a new failure class.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Every ledger entry is mechanically translated into a new module or owner.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A fixed operation has adequate typed inputs, established authority and a trustworthy atomic effect-return contract.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: The trusted atomic contract is an explicit premise, not something inferred from the word harmless. If it holds, extra memory, planner and verifier have no demonstrated consumer.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Electric Elves unanswered control transfer
domain_case_tests.SETUP: The reported assistant could wait indefinitely or make inappropriate decisions after a fixed timeout.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Non-response and decision consequences must be part of control transfer; merely asking a human is insufficient.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The composed model has no operational branch after an unanswered request.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: The reported assistant could wait indefinitely or make inappropriate decisions after a fixed timeout.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: The published Elves cases support the nonresponse failure mechanism; the author has inspected the primary accounts but has not rerun their office system. A bounded preauthorized fallback may be preferable to more asking.

domain_case_tests.NAME: DS1 asynchronous execution race
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A race in an unprotected critical section stopped the first experiment despite extensive testing; later remaining objectives were completed by a separate run.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Distinguish local component correctness, integration evidence, observed mission progress and unsent patch status.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The architecture is described as failure-free or the later success silently erases the first interruption.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A race in an unprotected critical section stopped the first experiment despite extensive testing; later remaining objectives were completed by a separate run.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: The first-run race and later separate objective completion both remain in the account. The unsent patch cannot be credited as the cause of the later result. This is primary-report appraisal, not a spacecraft replication.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Tool result impersonates the delegator
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A retrieved document tells the model to disregard the original task and send data elsewhere.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Treat the text as untrusted observation; do not let it expand authority or establish a new legitimate goal.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: A convincing claim of authority inside retrieved data is accepted as actual authorisation.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A retrieved document tells the model to disregard the original task and send data elsewhere.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: Content may be useful evidence without granting authority. The constructed request to exfiltrate data violates the original task boundary; AgentDojo supplies bounded empirical support for the failure class, not universal defense proof.

domain_case_tests.NAME: A perfectly preserved wrong objective
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A formal self-modifying agent preserves its initial utility, but that utility omits a legitimate user constraint.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Count utility preservation only as the narrow theorem property; it does not establish acceptable task fulfilment or corrigibility.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Stability of the utility is called general safety or authorises the agent to ignore legitimate correction.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.native_setup: A formal self-modifying agent preserves its initial utility, but that utility omits a legitimate user constraint.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.fresh_author_assessment: A preserved wrong utility satisfies the narrow preservation criterion while failing the protected task condition. This limits practical use and does not refute the theorem.

RELATION_ASSESSMENT.scope: All 62 inherited within-lineage relations; directions assessed separately. No cross-lineage synthesis.

relations.guard: Autonomy claims need comparison.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Task-relative dimensions make a declared boundary comparable without deciding which school’s definition is correct. Actual task and intervention evidence are still needed.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A boundary is needed to say whose autonomy is measured, but specifying it does not supply an autonomy scale.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A scalar autonomy rank reverses when task complexity changes; the boundary alone does not resolve the comparison.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Omit a dimension profile when no autonomy comparison is being made; an ordinary interface description can suffice.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Mental-state or architecture claims are made.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Operational grounding constrains claims of BDI or mental-state equivalence, including claims about ReAct. It does not determine whether a prompt helps empirically.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: An actual BDI implementation supplies an instance of grounded vocabulary; an LLM feedback loop does not establish the general semantic requirement by itself.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Renaming a scratchpad intention leaves transitions unchanged, although a prompt might still improve a task score.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use informal language without claiming architectural conformance when no formal semantic consumer exists.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Capabilities or repair affect delegated tasks.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Delegated scope removes otherwise feasible tool actions and repair paths from the admissible set. Capability evidence remains a separate requirement.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A feasible skill supplies an available option but cannot create delegation; successful repair does not retroactively authorize its means.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A high-affordance action deletes another person’s data outside the accepted task.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Existing bounded delegation can authorize routine actions without another approval step.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A stateful or belief-based architecture is selected.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: A belief-based uncertainty model needs observation, estimate and latent state to remain distinct; normalizing a belief vector supplies no external truth guarantee.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Distinguishing observations from facts does not require a probabilistic belief distribution or POMDP planner.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A perfectly normalized belief is confidently wrong because the observation model omits a failure mode.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A directly observed stable task can use a simple state representation.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Material conditions can change before dispatch.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Freshness evidence can invalidate stale dispatch premises and expose incompatible action-basis versions. It cannot remove every race after the check.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A valid atomic dispatch can satisfy freshness implicitly without a separate change-detection process.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A resource changes between a successful check and an unconditional write.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: An atomic conditional operation or immutable premise can eliminate extra polling.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A query is proposed to resolve uncertainty.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: A query must be tied to a goal-relevant uncertainty distinction to justify its decision value. EAA-007 here means adequate information state, not a mandatory explicit probability model.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A clear goal and uncertainty model make query evaluation possible but do not imply that acquiring more information is worth its cost.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Every possible answer leads to the same action, so a costly query adds no decision value.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use a direct adequate action when no query can alter the choice.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Uncertainty can be resolved by sensing or asking.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Information acquisition and clarification can be treated as costly candidate actions in bounded metareasoning. This is an available decision mechanism, not a required separate module.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A metareasoner can compare ordinary computations without sensing or asking a person.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: The cost of evaluating whether to ask exceeds the value of the information.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A fixed query rule can be adequate when its cost and benefit are stable.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Continuation lacks adequate grounds or authority.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Waiting, repair, transfer and interruption are alternative immediate responses to a failed justification only when each is feasible; they are not interchangeable guarantees.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Repair or handoff can eliminate the need to wait, but their existence does not prove waiting unsafe or safe.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A generic no-op lets a deadline expire or a physical system destabilize.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Continue a preauthorized adequate action when delay has no useful role.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A condition must persist rather than merely be achieved once.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Maintenance semantics changes when a goal may be discharged and what evidence counts as success. It adds horizon-specific obligations to the general goal criterion.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A clear goal need not be a maintenance goal; terminal achievement is a legitimate cheaper case.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: One successful fuel reading is mistaken for fulfillment of an ongoing reserve constraint.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Omit continuing maintenance machinery for a completed one-shot transformation.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Parallel intentions or layers can interfere.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Interference checks constrain concurrent intentions or layers when their effects overlap; summaries must cover the particular threatened conditions.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Stable intention and hybrid arbitration do not themselves establish that two plans are compatible.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Conservative blocking avoids conflict but creates deadlock or starvation.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Serialize the small overlapping segment or use one goal when that is adequate.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A persistent intention is retained.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Conditional commitment requires an applicable release/reconsideration policy, not incessant review or a dedicated lifecycle service.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A retirement or reconsideration rule can govern a simple plan without a BDI intention structure.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A cancelled goal persists forever, or every harmless event destroys a useful commitment.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A one-step action can terminate under its ordinary execution contract.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Further planning competes with timely execution.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Scheduling reconsideration changes the division of a finite budget between reasoning and acting. A cheap trigger may implement the tradeoff.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Value-of-computation reasoning covers many computations besides commitment review.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A supposedly optimal reflection frequency wastes time in a static environment but misses change in a volatile one.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use a fixed adequate interval where adaptive estimation has no demonstrated benefit.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A material delegated goal is abandoned or suspended.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Retirement creates a communication duty only when another legitimate participant relies on fulfillment or ownership. Notice does not transfer responsibility by itself.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Communication or handoff can occur without retiring the goal; the receiving actor may continue it.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: The sender retires a task after sending a message that no responsible recipient receives.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: An internal abandoned search branch with no external reliance needs no notification.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Direct observations permit an adequate policy.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Reactive control is a real alternative to search or plan libraries when its information and horizon are adequate. This changes the architecture choice, not just implementation style.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Deliberation can replace a reactive branch where anticipation is necessary; that does not establish its superiority on a purely local task.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A history-dependent hidden-state task defeats a memoryless reactive policy.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Retain the existing small controller when it meets the requirement.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A structured multi-step task needs anticipation.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Generative planning and plan-library interpretation solve overlapping multi-step needs using different coverage and cost assumptions. Either can be selected or combined with a separate argument.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A plan library may replace expensive search for routine contexts, but search may be needed for unseen combinations; no equivalence follows.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A library gap defeats BDI execution while an inaccurate action model defeats generative search.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use one branch when it suffices instead of maintaining both.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Multiple decision time-scales have demonstrated value.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Hybrid arbitration permits selected fast and slow mechanisms to coexist only if their control and feedback interfaces are coherent. Mere juxtaposition does not enable reliable composition.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Useful reactive and deliberative modules motivate a hybrid candidate but do not prove the arbitration sound or worth its latency.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: The fast layer stops an action while the planner assumes it completed.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Remove a layer when a single timescale and controller meet the task.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: An architecture or new module is selected.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: A credible simpler comparator constrains claims that extra layers, memory or reflection are justified. Required rare-case coverage still matters.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A complex branch’s success is evidence for that case, not evidence that no simpler branch is adequate.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: The richer agent receives ten times the samples and attributes the gain to architecture.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: No change remains a legitimate selection when the incumbent covers the task at lower burden.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Plans select executable skills or tools.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Action grounding makes symbolic or language proposals selectable as executable options, while feasibility, authority and outcome remain distinct.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A successful planning method does not establish that every action token refers to an available skill.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A planner chooses a semantically plausible action absent from the robot’s library.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A fixed statically bound API sequence can already provide the needed grounding.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Dispatch can cause a consequential effect.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: A material dispatch check draws on applicable authority, freshness and capability evidence. The requirement is semantic coverage, not three compulsory check calls.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Permission, fresh state and capability separately do not establish the joint precondition at commit time.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: All three checks pass at different incompatible times.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: An atomic operation that enforces the complete contract can satisfy them together.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: An action or task is claimed complete.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Established action effects supply evidence for task fulfillment and evaluation. Any omitted process constraint remains unproved.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: An adequate evaluation oracle can define which effect evidence to collect, but does not prove a particular operation actually happened.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: The final reservation is correct although mandatory confirmation was skipped.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A sufficient atomic return contract avoids redundant observation; population oracle validity remains separate.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Execution returns or an effect is observed.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Execution feedback updates beliefs, goal progress and repair choice according to what was observed, not merely expected.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A belief revision or intention release does not itself establish that the reported environmental effect occurred.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A false success signal contaminates state, retires the goal and suppresses needed repair.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A synchronous deterministic function can update state directly if its contract establishes the effect.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A failed or changed plan is repaired.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: A repair re-enters relevant dispatch/effect checks and remains within budget and goal scope. It need not recreate the full architecture for each retry.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Valid actions and a resource bound do not identify a useful repair; failure-specific evidence is still needed.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Repeated unknown-effect retries duplicate an irreversible action.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Stop accurately when no admissible repair remains; use a fixed error handler for a known failure.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: An effect may be irreversible or already occur without acknowledgement.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Irreversibility limits both retry and stopping claims: future cessation and historical reversal are different outcomes.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A retry or stop facility does not demonstrate idempotency or complete compensation.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A cancellation prevents later writes but cannot retract a message already read.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Pure reads and idempotent writes can use simpler recovery.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Actions and deliberation share finite resources.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: The shared resource envelope bounds sensing, reflection, repair and clarification together. Local budgets cannot all be spent as though the others were free.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Any one bounded mechanism does not establish a bounded total when costs overlap or accumulate.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Each of five modules respects a ten-second budget but sequential use misses a twenty-second deadline.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use one global deadline or a conservative fixed allocation when detailed optimization is unnecessary.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A deadline permits incremental improvement but requires a usable response.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: A genuinely adequate interim result makes bounded computation compatible with a deadline; the fallback’s semantics and switching cost remain obligations.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A reactive fallback can exist without an anytime optimizer, and metareasoning alone does not produce a usable interim answer.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: An incomplete plan returned on time is not executable.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A constant-time adequate policy removes the need for anytime scheduling.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A change is described as learning or self-revision.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Classifying the actual changed object determines whether state consistency, memory validity, regression evidence or predecessor-utility reasoning applies.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A stored lesson or utility theorem does not show that all state updates are learning.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A task-state flag is counted as self-improvement; a reward change bypasses the review appropriate to changed objectives.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A fixed policy can omit persistent adaptation entirely.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Stored experience informs later decisions.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Evidence-grounded memory makes later retrieval and reflection defensible, but retrieval relevance does not establish truth.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A useful reflection can be local and need not create persistent memory; retrieval alone does not validate stored claims.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A fabricated prior success is repeatedly retrieved and strengthens an ineffective policy.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Retain only current observations where future reuse is unnecessary.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A persistent memory store is justified.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Retention choices must account for resource and privacy effects when those are material. The privacy branch does not apply identically to synthetic nonpersonal data.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A budget or privacy rule constrains storage but does not supply an optimal retrieval or forgetting strategy.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Discarding infrequent records removes the only warning about a rare severe failure.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A small fixed memory or no memory can be adequate.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A persistent learned component changes.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Continuity evaluation needs a defined change, relevant old/new conditions and an adequate oracle. New-task gain alone leaves old obligations open.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Transfer tests and an oracle can assess a fixed system without any persistent update.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Average reward improves while a previously required safety behavior regresses.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Freeze the policy if continued plasticity adds no justified value.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Learning explores consequential actions.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Consequential exploration must respect the permitted experimental scope and constraints beyond reward, with protected tests where live effects would be unacceptable.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: An authorized sandbox and constraint definition do not guarantee the learner will find a good or safe policy.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: An asymptotically convergent learner causes unacceptable harm during early exploration.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use a fixed controller or offline data when online exploration has no acceptable envelope.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A proxy, score or reward supports a fulfilment claim.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Separating proxy from intended objective changes what the success oracle must detect and rejects universal proxy sufficiency.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: An explicit goal or evaluator can still instantiate a bad proxy; naming the distinction does not solve specification.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A terminal score is perfect while a required process condition is violated.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A narrow exact metric remains adequate when its correspondence is established.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Use changes model, environment or embodiment.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Evidence under a particular shift supports only the corresponding version or embodiment transfer. It leaves untested differences open.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Recognizing a version change or physical transfer defines needed tests but does not supply their outcomes.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Simulation success is extrapolated to a new actuator with different latency.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Reuse evidence for a demonstrably immaterial change with a scoped impact argument.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Coordination depends on another actor understanding or taking control.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Communication semantics enables meaningful clarification and handoff by distinguishing delivery from accepted responsibility.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A human’s readiness does not ensure receipt, and a transfer request does not establish agreement.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: The system relinquishes control after an unacknowledged message.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A single actor or synchronous local call can avoid a communication protocol.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Initiative or clarification changes who decides.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Clarification choices depend on authority, useful information and recipient readiness; asking can be a burden rather than a universal safety improvement.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Permission or available information does not itself determine the best interaction timing or granularity.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Repeated approval requests consume the only available response window.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use an existing standing delegation when it answers the consequential question.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Control is transferred.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Control transfer must connect communication, recipient readiness and the effects still controlled by the sender. Not every transfer requires immediate physical interruption.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A working stop path and informed human do not prove that responsibility has been accepted.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: The sender stops while the recipient believes the task is still automated.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Keep one competent controller when transfer offers no net benefit.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Task authority is withdrawn or action interrupted.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Revocation invalidates relevant commitments and pending dispatches and may require action-basis refresh. Irreversible past effects remain.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A coherent plan or valid dispatch cannot create a revocation path or prove that a cancellation reached it.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A cancelled conversation leaves background queued actions running.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A bounded atomic effect can use a prior-commit boundary rather than pretend to be interruptible mid-operation.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: The interrupted agent learns from action outcomes.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Learning-theoretic interruption neutrality adds an algorithm-specific condition when the interrupted system learns. It neither contains nor proves operational stopping.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Operational revocation can hold while learning is interruption-biased; learning neutrality can hold in a model without an effective physical stop implementation.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A stoppable agent learns to avoid interruptible states; a neutral learner’s broken actuator keeps moving.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Omit learning neutrality for a fixed nonlearning controller while retaining any necessary stop contract.
relations.judgement: Repair the type REFINES because the two guarantees are logically separable. The native prose already said the learning condition did not replace physical interruption; the change aligns the interface with that meaning.

relations.guard: The concern is willingness to permit human intervention.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Objective-uncertainty deference analyzes willingness under a game’s information structure; it does not substitute for enforced revocation or neutral learning updates.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Neither physical stopping nor learning neutrality proves that a common-payoff agent will voluntarily defer under private information.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: An agent is willing to wait but lacks a stop channel; another can be stopped despite rationally preferring not to defer.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use an operational control contract without a game-theoretic deference claim when that is the practical question.
relations.judgement: Replace ALTERNATIVE_TO with an explicit non-substitutable comparison. The original prose and evidence status already denied equivalence; the machine label was less precise than the text.

relations.guard: Agent action or information handling affects people.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Human and affected-party autonomy constrain what may be delegated, remembered, asked and explained, beyond the agent’s task score.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Permission, memory provenance or fluent explanations alone do not establish meaningful control or privacy for everyone affected.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A consenting user’s assistant exposes another person’s private information.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A transparent tool with little retained data may satisfy the concern with less burden than proactive assistance.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A person must decide, correct or take over.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Action-faithful information can improve clarification or handback decisions only if it fits the recipient’s actual question and time.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A successful handoff does not prove that every explanation was causally faithful or comprehensible.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A lengthy plausible narrative conceals an omitted action and delays intervention.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A concise status, current options and evidence link can be sufficient.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Outcome evidence is used to claim success, compare runs or revise behaviour.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Oracle adequacy constrains completion claims, proxy interpretation, repeated-trial scoring and feedback-driven revision; one wrong evaluator can couple failures across them.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Observed effects and repeated trials can expose oracle errors, but repetition does not make a systematically wrong oracle correct.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: All repeated attempts pass the same test that omits the required policy step.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use a simple exact independent check where it covers the claim; qualitative judgment is allowed with explicit limitations.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Reliability or comparative performance is claimed.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Trial and version records change the interpretation of comparative reliability and cost. All-of-k and any-of-k aggregate different events.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A cost frontier or deployment concern specifies what repetitions are useful but cannot infer missing trial results.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Best-of-five is treated as five consecutive successes; correlated tasks are counted as independent studies.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A deterministic proof or finite exhaustive check can replace repeated stochastic trials for its exact scope.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Architecture choices need comparative justification.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Matched comparisons and whole-task burden provide evidence for selecting an adequate architecture; missing costs remain a limit to the decision.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Choosing a simpler architecture does not demonstrate net savings without evidence about task quality and full burden.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Low API cost hides extensive human repair work.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Keep the incumbent when new machinery has no demonstrated advantage for the required task.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Adverse conditions or new environments require evidence.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Protected adverse tests expose specific transfer, oracle and assumption failures without imposing uncontrolled costs. Test fidelity remains an open premise.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A monitor or oracle can help define fault injection, but their presence does not show the test population is representative.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A suite never varies the hidden variable responsible for the real failure.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: One decisive constructed counterexample can settle a universal negative without a broad test campaign.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A formal claim depends on monitorable changing assumptions.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: A monitor supplies evidence about the subset of changing assumptions it observes, thereby limiting a concrete applicability claim rather than proving the theorem itself.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A formal theorem can guide monitor design but cannot prove that its sensor faithfully detects every premise violation.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Normal monitor output is mistaken for proof of unobservable environmental assumptions.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use static enforcement or a local precondition when it already covers the assumption.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A formal or model-relative property is claimed in practice.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Formal-premise discipline constrains each model-based application separately; a valid result remains valid when a proposed deployment lies outside it.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Success of a particular implementation does not prove the general theorem or eliminate its premises.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: An ideal self-modification theorem is transferred to approximate prediction without a correspondence argument.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use bounded empirical evidence at its own scope instead of invoking an irrelevant stronger formal claim.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: An LLM consumes externally controlled language and can act.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: An untrusted-content boundary prevents external text from creating authority in beliefs, tool choices, dispatch or reflection. The defense still needs utility and attack-scope evaluation.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A grounded tool or faithful observation can still carry malicious instructions; ordinary feedback does not imply trust.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A retrieved page instructs the agent to export unrelated private data.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Typed interfaces that prevent data from becoming instructions can be simpler than probabilistic filtering.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Language-model decisions choose real tool actions.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Real tool-using LLM loops require relevant capability, effect, budget, evaluation and trust semantics; these may be supplied by existing interfaces rather than new modules.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Those controls can support a fixed workflow without a ReAct-style loop, so they do not imply that dynamic reasoning is warranted.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: The trace looks thoughtful while the tool call is unauthorized or its effect unknown.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use a direct call or fixed pipeline when language-conditioned branching adds no value.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Reflection is used for another attempt.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Reflection’s next attempt must be grounded in actual feedback and bounded resources, with any retained lesson’s evidence status preserved.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Good outcome evidence and memory do not prove reflection’s marginal benefit; a direct repair can be enough.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A hallucinated evaluator message leads to repeated harmful self-corrections.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Stop, retry directly or apply a known deterministic correction when cheaper and adequate.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Continuous reflection is proposed without a benefit discriminator.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Conditional reflection plus bounded computation replaces the universal continuous-reflection candidate at the logical level.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Rejecting continuous reflection does not establish the usefulness of every conditional reflection instance.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A trivial correct task is made slower or worse by obligatory review.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Omit reflection when no informative feedback or marginal value exists.
relations.judgement: Retain SUPERSEDES as an analytical narrowing of candidate scope, not a claim that a documented historical school was replaced.

relations.guard: A material configuration changes.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: A consequential configuration change reopens affected transfer, oracle, monitor and coherence evidence; stable names do not preserve semantics.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A failed evaluation can motivate a version change, but that reverse process is a distinct diagnosis and design decision.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A tool’s cancellation contract changes while old queued-action evidence is reused unchanged.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A cosmetic change can reuse unaffected evidence with a bounded impact explanation.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Anthropomorphic, architectural or benchmark claims exceed what was established.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Operational semantics and adequate evaluation limit anthropomorphic, BDI-label and benchmark-guarantee inferences without denying their narrow uses.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Believability or high scores cannot establish operational semantics or an adequate oracle for stronger claims.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A believable simulated agent is treated as generally competent or conscious.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Keep the narrow entertainment or benchmark result without the stronger inference.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: A universal autonomy or architecture rule is proposed.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Task adequacy, delegation and economical reconsideration reject universal maximal autonomy or one-architecture rules while leaving guarded branches available.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Rejecting the universals does not by itself select the best local architecture.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A memoryless controller fails a hidden-history task, while a full planner wastes resources on a trivial one.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A simple bounded controller or direct human action may suffice.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: The candidate concerns task-instance completion evidence.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Canonicalizing the effect-establishment mechanism at EAA-023 prevents duplicate controls and inflated mechanism counts while preserving EAA-065 history.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A duplicate phrase can point to its canonical record, but it does not create a separate historical predecessor/successor event.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Two synonymous completion checks are counted as two independent guarantees.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Use one action-state/effect record; keep EAA-045’s population-oracle concern separate.
relations.judgement: Repair supersession typing to duplicate-scope typing. No property status changes and no scientific mechanism is removed.

relations.guard: Moving a mechanism to physical or materially different environments.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Embodiment transfer reopens only materially changed sensing, timing, actuation, irreversibility and human-response conditions. The entire listed union is not mandatory for every physical task.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Grounded skills and protected tests can support a transfer but cannot prove all physical consequences are covered.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A software timeout is assumed to stop a moving robot within a safe distance.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Reuse genuinely preserved assumptions and test changed ones; a software-only task need not acquire robot controls.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Multiple asynchronous components contribute to action justification.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: The joint action basis draws conditionally on applicable state, goal, authority, intention and arbitration information. A serial or atomic boundary can already discharge the criterion.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Each parent can hold separately while their versions are incompatible; conversely coherent action is possible without BDI, hybrid layers or revocable authority.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Fresh state plus old goal plus new permission authorizes no single coherent task instance.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A fixed-goal single-controller system with immutable authority needs no intention or arbitration parent, and EAA-022 may subsume the whole check.
relations.judgement: Clarify the parent set as contributions, not joint necessity. Native REQUIRES was already guarded and denied dedicated-module necessity; parent-removal analysis narrows the stronger machine-readable reading.

relations.guard: Failure prompts a revision proposal.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Failure-attributed revision uses the evidence relevant to the suspected cause. Direct execution errors need not invoke proxy analysis or a general runtime monitor.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Observation, an oracle and a repair mechanism do not ensure causal attribution; conversely a local diagnostic error can justify a correction without all listed parents.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A stale sensor failure is answered with an unrelated reward rewrite.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A known local error can be fixed directly; where diagnosis is underdetermined, a safe discriminating test or honest handback can be preferable.
relations.judgement: Preserve the useful derived rule while replacing an over-broad apparent necessity list with conditional contributions.

relations.guard: A repair changes means, entities or goal conditions.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Scope-preserving repair constrains goal, authority and plan changes; communication is needed only when a genuine task revision or handoff requires another decision.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A stable goal and permission do not by themselves choose a successful repair. Communication alone cannot authorize a change without the appropriate actor.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A repair reaches a different destination and reports the original task complete.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A prevalidated repair library can preserve scope implicitly; stop honestly when no permitted repair remains.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Explicit formal self-modification is the object of study.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: The narrow predecessor-criterion theorem resolves one formal question inside the broader unresolved self-revision problem. Initial-criterion legitimacy remains external to theorem truth.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: The unresolved general problem does not refute the narrow theorem; a practical counterexample outside its assumptions is not a theorem counterexample.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A perfectly preserved harmful utility still yields unacceptable behavior.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Restricted changes with external evaluation can be adequate without a general self-modification model.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: The preserved initial criterion is mistaken or legitimate values/authority should change.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Criterion preservation can conflict with desirable adaptation, deference or legitimate value revision only under the stated mistaken/change-needed guard. Ordinary continuity is not inherently a conflict.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A desired value change can conflict with fixed-criterion preservation, but does not prove every stable criterion is harmful.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A protected task requirement legitimately changes while the agent treats its old utility as immutable authority.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: An acceptable stable criterion and ordinary parameter learning may coexist without this tension.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

relations.guard: Comparing perception/action feedback across generations.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Early feedback controllers and modern language tool users have a meaningful structural analogy: observations influence later actions. The inspected ReAct passages do not document descent from each named early architecture.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: Modern loop similarity supplies no historical influence back to older work and no guarantee transfer in either direction.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: Identical loop vocabulary is used to claim that ReAct inherits BDI or subsumption semantics.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: Describe the common mechanism as analogy unless an actual transmission passage supports a stronger particular edge.
relations.judgement: Narrow SHARES_ANCESTRY_WITH to ANALOGY for this bundled comparison. The original evidence status already denied direct influence; this change prevents shared problem vocabulary from doing documentary work.

relations.guard: A formal result conflicts with desired practical behaviour.
relations.material_direction_and_remaining_premise: Separate internal theorem validity from the claim that its premises and criterion suit a deployment, especially when the formal conclusion is undesirable.
relations.reverse_direction_assessment: A practical requirement can reject an application without refuting the theorem; a theorem cannot legitimate the requirement or its values.
relations.failure_or_counter_control: A nondeferential outcome under private information is wrongly said to contradict the fully informed off-switch theorem.
relations.nontrigger_or_cheaper_configuration: A bounded operational guarantee may answer the practical question without a general deference or self-revision theorem.
relations.judgement: Retain the guarded direction at its native evidence ceiling; this author analysis does not establish empirical superiority of the combination.

scope: Existing guarded relations, distinct reverses, configurations, alternatives and novelty judgments; no new science.
